messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "call if you experience severe restlessness"
set: ["call if you experience severe restlessness", "call if you experience irritability", "call if you experience aggressive behavior", "call if you experience frenzied abnormal excitement", "call your doctor if you experience agitation", "call your doctor if you experience extreme worry", "call your doctor if you experience panic attacks", "call your doctor right away if you experience agitation", "call your doctor right away if you experience extreme worry", "call your doctor right away if you experience panic attacks", "call your doctor right away if you experience new or worsening depression", "call healthcare provider if symptoms are severe", "contact your healthcare provider if you experience widespread, severe itching on stopping this medication", "call if you act without thinking", "call your doctor at once if you have severe stomach pain or vomiting", "call doctor if chest pain is severe or ongoing"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
